description: Freeze and frost risk (NWS) — Freeze and frost risk for a US point over the next 1-7 days from NOAA NWS hourly gridpoint forecasts: verdict NO_FREEZE / FROST_RISK / FREEZE / HARD_FREEZE, first freeze and hard-freeze hour (local time), hours at or below 32/28/24/20F, longest freeze run, frost-likely hours (33-36F with clear sky and light wind), pipe-burst risk, daily lows with light/moderate/severe freeze category, active Frost Advisory / Freeze Watch / Freeze Warning / Hard Freeze alerts, and plain-language actions for plants, pets and pipes. Params: lat, lon, optional days (1-7, default 7). Public-domain NWS data. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_freeze
